description: Audit a property's recent deeds and real estate transfer tax filings against current county tax rolls to identify unmapped deed backlogs, buyer/grantee mailing address drift, and nominal consideration transfers requiring Exhibit N (Attestation of Identity & Standing under T.C.A. § 67-4-409 and § 67-5-1407).

current_roll_mailing.description: Optional current mailing address on county tax roll

current_roll_owner.description: Optional current property owner on county tax roll

name: audit_property_transfers
